membership: all 24 frozen walk-node source cells; 18 unique Phase3B.1 visible units for attribution
snapshot_rule: exact recorded elapsed_s per walk node; require snapshot before node endpoint; retain missingness
geometric_field_policy: mark unavailable unless directly recorded at the fixed snapshot; never interpolate from endpoint or replay physics
trend: predeclared 2s minus node-entry height and absolute tilt; no fitted threshold
descriptive_baseline: always-risk binary comparator and fixed-feature PASS/FAIL overlap at each snapshot; no threshold optimization or generalization claim
analysis_units: report both source cells and unique visible units; mission-case clusters retained
stop_rule: stop after source/trace integrity and fixed-snapshot observability audit; if required geometric fields are absent, do not infer early geometry separation or call Jev
